meta.description: Finds due follow-ups (Salesforce-first; followup_jobs Data Table as technical fallback), re-checks every suppression/consent/stage/hours condition immediately before sending, enforces max attempts, cancels on customer reply, and records why each follow-up was sent or skipped.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: ={{ (() => { const m = (JSON.parse($env.SF_FIELD_MAP_JSON || '{}').mappings || {}); const need = ['followup_date','followup_attempt','mobile_phone','ai_enabled','human_takeover','sms_consent','sms_opt_out','last_inbound_date']; const f = {}; for (const k of need) { const s = m[k]; f[k] = s && s.field !== 'UNMAPPED' && s.object === 'Lead' ? s.field : null; } if (!f.followup_date) return 'SELECT Id FROM Lead WHERE Id = null'; const sel = ['Id','FirstName','Status', ...Object.values(f).filter(Boolean)]; const extra = [f.ai_enabled ? `${f.ai_enabled} = true` : null, f.human_takeover ? `${f.human_takeover} = false` : null, f.sms_opt_out ? `${f.sms_opt_out} = false` : null].filter(Boolean).join(' AND '); return `SELECT ${[...new Set(sel)].join(', ')} FROM Lead WHERE ${f.followup_date} <= ${new Date().toISOString()}${extra ? ' AND ' + extra : ''} LIMIT 50`; })() }}

options.$comment: Returns zero rows when followup_date is UNMAPPED — the Data Table fallback below then drives scheduling.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const it = $('Compose Follow-Up Message').item.json; const m = (JSON.parse($env.SF_FIELD_MAP_JSON || '{}').mappings || {}); const body = {}; const fa = m.followup_attempt, fd = m.followup_date; const policy = JSON.parse($env.FOLLOWUP_POLICY_JSON || '{}'); const seq = ((policy.followups || {}).schedule_hours_after_last_inbound) || [24, 72, 168]; if (fa && fa.field !== 'UNMAPPED' && fa.object === 'Lead') body[fa.field] = it.attempt; if (fd && fd.field !== 'UNMAPPED' && fd.object === 'Lead') { const nextIdx = it.attempt; body[fd.field] = nextIdx < seq.length ? new Date(Date.now() + seq[nextIdx] * 3600000).toISOString() : null; } return JSON.stringify(body); })() }}

options.$comment: Sets next followup_date or clears it after the final attempt (max_attempts enforcement is also in the recheck).

Terminal skip reasons cancel the job (prevents endless nurture loops); transient ones (outside hours) leave it scheduled for the next run. Salesforce-sourced skips just log via the error branch when no job row exists.
